reviewNotes: The Olukumi, who speak a language related to Yoruba, live among the Anioma (Aniocha North); not yet mapped.
Ebu (Oshimili North) is Igala speaking; see Igala.
name: Anioma (Enuani)

summary.text: The Enuani speaking peoples of Aniocha and Oshimili, on the west bank of the Niger around Asaba, Ibusa, Ogwashi-Uku, Issele and Illah. Enuani is a dialect of Igbo. Their identity is debated: the Obuzor of Ibusa and Senator Ned Nwoko say the Anioma are Igbo, while the Asagba of Asaba and a 2025 communique of Aniocha and Oshimili leaders say “Anioma is Anioma; Anioma is not Igbo”, a culture area of Bini, Igala, Yoruba and Igbo origins.
